title: The Lotus Sutra, Part 3
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The main teaching of this Soto Zen dharma talk is that cultivating kindness and acceptance towards oneself by imagining a warm relationship with someone else can help develop self-compassion and understanding. By letting go of judgment and separation, we can break down distinctions between ourselves and others, leading to greater connection and understanding. This practice can also help us recognize our own limitations and imperfections, allowing us to approach life with humility and dedication to the Buddha's way.
topics: Soto Zen dharma talk topics/concepts: cultivating relationality
